lines.en: label day86:
scene hall_day
I decide to leave the girls to their own devices in gym class today.
lines.zh: 今天的体育课，我决定让女孩们自己折腾去。

lines.en: Are they going to be fine on their own? Probably not. But I put Makoto in charge so, at the very least, everyone will be mostly contained.
lines.zh: 她们自己能行吗？大概不行。不过我把 Makoto 留下管着，所以至少大家基本还管得住。

lines.en: Well, everybody except Futaba, that is.
lines.zh: 嗯，当然，除了 Futaba 之外。

lines.en: Which isn't to say that she became some sort of delinquent overnight. I mean, how could she when she never even showed up to the class?
lines.zh: 倒不是说她一夜之间变成了什么不良少女。我是说，她连课都不来上，怎么变不良啊。

lines.en: In fact, the main reason I decided to wander the halls is to find her.
lines.zh: 事实上，我之所以决定在走廊里晃悠，主要就是为了找她。

lines.en: I get that gym class can be taxing when you aren’t comfortable with your body, but it's not like running away is going to do anything to change that.
lines.zh: 我明白，如果你对自己的身体不自在，体育课会是一种折磨，可逃跑也改变不了什么啊。

lines.en: Especially when consistently running away is a thing that would probably get me in trouble if any of the other staff members found out.
lines.zh: 尤其是一直这么逃，万一被其他教职员发现了，我大概也要跟着倒霉。

lines.en: It's not like I don't want to help her, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，我不是不想帮她。

lines.en: I just don't know how...
lines.zh: 我只是不知道该怎么帮……

lines.en: Especially when I don't even know where she is.
lines.zh: 尤其当我连她在哪儿都不知道的时候。

lines.en: scene black
Now...
lines.zh: 那么……

lines.en: Where would I go if I didn’t want to participate in class?
lines.zh: 如果我不想上课，我会躲到哪儿去？

lines.en: scene futabanurse1
: Ah...S...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 啊……S……Sensei……

lines.en: : I knew it.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : What...are you doing in here?
lines.zh: : 你……来这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be in gym?
lines.zh: : 你不是应该在上体育课吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t that what I should be asking you? Why are you in the nurse’s office?
lines.zh: : 这话该我问你吧？你为什么在保健室里？

lines.en: : And...why isn't the nurse here?
lines.zh: : 还有……保健老师怎么不在？

lines.en: scene futabanurse2
: The nurse...doesn't work on Fridays.
lines.zh: : 保健老师……星期五不上班。

lines.en: jump futabanursex
label futabanursex:
: And I didn't really want to go to gym today, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我今天实在不想上体育课，所以……

lines.en: : I decided to...take shelter here instead. I think I'd rather be alone right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 我就决定……躲到这儿来避难。反正我现在更想一个人待着。

lines.en: : Well, that sucks for you.
lines.zh: : 那可真不巧。

lines.en: scene futabanurse3
: Are you really going to make me go back right now? Yumi is-
lines.zh: : 你真的要我现在就回去吗？Yumi 她——

lines.en: : Who said anything about going back? I’m just going to hang out with you in here.
lines.zh: : 谁说要你回去了？我只是打算在这儿陪你待着。

lines.en: scene futabanurse4
: Well...thank you. But we both know that you shouldn’t be doing that.
lines.zh: : 那个……谢谢你。不过我们都清楚，你不该这么做的。

lines.en: : Sometimes, it’s better to do the things that we shouldn’t do than the things we should.
lines.zh: : 有时候，做不该做的事反而比做该做的事更好。

lines.en: : Is that...supposed to be inspirational?
lines.zh: : 这……算是一句励志格言吗？

lines.en: : Beats me. But I’m going to hang out with you in here because I also don’t want to be bothered with teaching today.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过我要在这儿陪你，是因为我今天也不想费心教课。

lines.en: scene futabanurse5
: You...don’t ever really teach during gym anyway...
lines.zh: : 你……体育课上本来也没怎么真的教过……

lines.en: : Or...at all anymore, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 或者说……现在想想，你已经根本不教了。

lines.en: : Are you trying to start something, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你是想挑事吗，Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabanurse3
: S-Start something? Me? What would I even start?
lines.zh: : 挑、挑事？我？我能挑什么事啊？

lines.en: : I promise I wasn’t trying to offend you.
lines.zh: : 我保证我没有要冒犯你的意思。

lines.en: : Too late, Futaba. I’m horribly offended. So offended that I might even have to give you what I imagine will be your first detention ever.
lines.zh: : 太晚了，Futaba。我被深深地冒犯了。冒犯到说不定得给你一个我猜是你人生中第一次的留堂处分。

lines.en: scene futabanurse6
: Will you still give me detention if I pout like this? Just look how sad I am.
lines.zh: : 那如果我这样噘嘴，你还会给我留堂吗？你看我多伤心啊。

lines.en: scene futabanurse6r
: I'm sorry. I’ve just...seen Ami use that technique before and it always seems to work on you...
lines.zh: : 对不起。我只是……以前见过 Ami 用这招，而且似乎每次对你都管用……

lines.en: : I can't imagine that I was anywhere near as cute as she is when she does it, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我想我做起来肯定远远没有她可爱……

lines.en: : It worked and you no longer have detention. Congratulations, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 这招奏效了，你不用留堂了。恭喜你，Futaba。

lines.en: : I obviously was never going to give you detention anyway, but now I’m definitely not going to. So, yeah. Good job.
lines.zh: : 反正我本来也压根没打算给你留堂，不过现在就更不可能了。所以嘛，干得漂亮。

lines.en: scene futabanurse4
: Umm...thank you? I think...
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢？大概吧……

lines.en: : You're welcome. I think.
lines.zh: : 不客气。大概吧。

lines.en: : You know...you're really hard to follow sometimes, Sensei. I feel like I...never truly understand what sort of mood you're in.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你有时候真的很难捉摸，Sensei。我总觉得……自己从没真正搞懂过你是什么心情。

lines.en: : To be fair, neither do I most of the time. And I can pretty much guarantee that that won't be changing any time soon.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我自己大多数时候也搞不懂。而且我基本可以保证，短期内这一点不会改变。

lines.en: scene futabanurse6r2
: Good. I don't really know how I'd react if you were just...suddenly a different person.
lines.zh: : 那就好。要是你突然……变成了另一个人，我真不知道自己会怎么反应。

lines.en: : I do. But I'm sure that me saying that is just another thing making me hard to follow.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不过我敢肯定，我说这话本身又是一件让你觉得我难捉摸的事。

lines.en: : How...would you know my reaction to that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道我的反应呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : You know, I'm just going to provide the typical cop out answer of it coming to me in a dream.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，我就套一个最常见的敷衍答案吧——我梦见的。

lines.en: : A dream? Are you the type of person to have strange dreams like that often, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 梦？Sensei 你是那种经常做这种奇怪的梦的人吗？

lines.en: : Not really. In fact, I barely dream at all- and most of the dreams I do have are a little too sexual to talk about in the school nurse's office.
lines.zh: : 算不上。事实上我几乎不做梦——而就算做了，大部分也色情得不适合在学校保健室里谈。

lines.en: scene futabanurse7
: S...Sexual?!
lines.zh: : 色、色情？！

lines.en: : Well, I...suppose that it is normal for men to dream of things like that...
lines.zh: : 那个……我想男人梦到这种事应该挺正常的吧……

lines.en: : It's normal for anyone to dream of things like that. We're free to have sex with anyone we want as long as it's in our dreams, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 任何人梦到这种事都很正常。只要是在梦里，我们想跟谁做爱都可以，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabanurse8
: I don't...really know how you're expecting me to reply to that, but...my dreams are typically less...umm...{i}that?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道你指望我怎么回答这个，不过……我的梦一般没那么……嗯……{i}那样{/i}？

lines.en: : Are you saying you {i}don't{/i} dream about having sex with me? I'm offended.
lines.zh: : 你是说你{i}没{/i}梦见过跟我做爱？我伤心了。

lines.en: scene futabanurse9
: I thought you didn't want to talk about this in the nurse's office?!
lines.zh: : 你不是说不想在保健室里聊这个吗？！

lines.en: For the first time in...probably forever, Futaba lets out a shockingly loud scream.
lines.zh: 大概是这辈子头一回，Futaba 发出了一声响得吓人的尖叫。

lines.en: It's so loud, in fact, that if there was anyone near the nurse's office, I imagine they would have come rushing in right away.
lines.zh: 事实上那声音大得，如果保健室附近真有人，我想他们早就冲进来了。

lines.en: Thankfully, this place is located a few halls down from the actual classrooms, so we {i}should{/i} be safe, I think.
lines.zh: 幸好这里离真正的教室隔着几条走廊，所以我想我们{i}应该{/i}安全。

lines.en: : Calm down. You want to be alone, don't you? Yelling will just draw attention.
lines.zh: : 冷静点。你想一个人待着，不是吗？大喊大叫只会引来注意。

lines.en: : Besides, it wouldn't be weird if you had dreams like that about me. I'm sure you've popped up in some of mine before.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你梦见我也没什么好奇怪的。我敢肯定你之前也出现在我的某些梦里过。

lines.en: scene futabanurse10
: Why would you dream about me when there are so many other {i}prettier{/i} girls you could be dreaming about?
lines.zh: : 明明有那么多{i}更漂亮{/i}的女孩可以梦，你为什么会梦见我呢？

lines.en: : You're very pretty yourself, Futaba. And you shouldn't be worried about those girls at all when you have two secret weapons tucked inside of your blazer.
lines.zh: : 你自己就很漂亮啊，Futaba。而且你外套里藏着两件秘密武器，根本不用去在意那些女孩。

lines.en: : Weapons? But I'm not carrying-
lines.zh: : 武器？可我没带——

lines.en: scene futabanurse11
: Oh.
: Yup.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: scene futabanurse12
: You haven’t even seen them, though...What if your dreams weren't an...accurate representation?
lines.zh: : 可是你根本没见过它们啊……万一你的梦……没有如实还原呢？

lines.en: : Not seeing them is precisely why I have to rely on dreams, Futaba. I am simply working with what I have.
lines.zh: : 正因为没见过，我才只能靠梦啊，Futaba。我只是在用手头仅有的材料。

lines.en: scene futabanurse12r
: So...if by some weird coincidence you {i}did{/i} happen to see them...what then?
lines.zh: : 那么……要是碰巧你{i}真的{/i}看到了它们……会怎样呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...If by some weird coincidence you saw them...and didn't have a reason to dream anymore...would your opinion of me change?
lines.zh: : 我是说……要是碰巧你看到了……就再也没有做梦的理由了……你对我的看法会变吗？

lines.en: : Since there’d be no more mystery left...what would happen to me?
lines.zh: : 既然神秘感都没了……我会变成什么样？

lines.en: : Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 什么都不会变。

lines.en: : Well that’s a relief...For a second, I-
lines.zh: : 那我就放心了……有那么一瞬间，我——

lines.en: : I'd have to touch them first, too.
lines.zh: : 我还得先摸过它们才行。

lines.en: scene futabanurse11
: Hah...of course.
lines.zh: : 哈……也是哦。

lines.en: : I am a simple man.
lines.zh: : 我这人很单纯。

lines.en: : Then, after you touch them-
lines.zh: : 那么，在你摸过之后——

lines.en: : I’d have to fuck them.
lines.zh: : 我还得操它们。

lines.en: scene futabanurse15
: Is that even a thing that you can do?!
lines.zh: : 这种事真的做得到吗？！

lines.en: : Futaba, even if no one is around right now, you need to stop screaming.
lines.zh: : Futaba，就算现在周围没人，你也别再尖叫了。

lines.en: scene futabanurse14
: Well, I'm sorry, Sensei. But you just said something absolutely ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 那个，对不起啦，Sensei。可你刚才说的实在太离谱了。

lines.en: : You...seriously haven't heard of titfucking before? Boobjobs?
lines.zh: : 你……真的没听说过乳交吗？胸推？

lines.en: scene futabanurse16
: Were those really the best names they could come up with?
lines.zh: : 他们真的想不出更好的名字了吗？

lines.en: : How...how does that sort of thing even work? I don't get how that could possibly feel good.
lines.zh: : 那、那种事到底是怎么做的？我不明白那样怎么可能会舒服。

lines.en: : Don't say it, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 别说，Sensei。

lines.en: : I could show you?
lines.zh: : 我可以示范给你看？

lines.en: scene futabanurse15
: We’re in school! There's no way we can do something like that!
lines.zh: : 我们可是在学校里！这种事怎么可能做得到啊！

lines.en: : {i}Especially when I don't even know what to do!
lines.zh: : {i}尤其我连该怎么做都不知道！{/i}

lines.en: : I mean, if you actually think about it, it should be pretty easy to figure out what to do.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你要是真动脑子想想，该怎么做应该挺容易摸清的。

lines.en: scene futabanurse16
: Are you...really serious about this?
lines.zh: : 你……是认真的吗？

lines.en: : You're not...put off at all that we're in school?
lines.zh: : 我们可是学校里……你一点都不介意吗？

lines.en: : I was at first. But the fact that you have now screamed three times and no one has come barging in has instilled a new wave of confidence in me.
lines.zh: : 一开始是介意的。不过你已经尖叫了三次，还没人闯进来，这让我重新燃起了一波信心。

lines.en: scene futabanurse14
: That just makes {i}me{/i} think we need better security...
lines.zh: : 这只会让{i}我{/i}觉得我们学校的安保该加强了……

lines.en: scene black
: We probably do. Now, come on.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。好了，过来。

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei...this is a joke right? You can't actually be serious right now.
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei……这是在开玩笑吧？你不可能真的认真的。

lines.en: : I'm extremely serious. Get over here.
lines.zh: : 我认真得不能再认真了。过来。

lines.en: : I really don't-
lines.zh: : 我真的不——

lines.en: : Futaba, come.
lines.zh: : Futaba，过来。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Ugh...
: Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: I move aside a curtain closing off one of the private infirmary beds and wait for Futaba to follow me inside before shutting it once again.
lines.zh: 我拉开隔开其中一张隔离病床的帘子，等 Futaba 跟进来之后，又把它拉上。

lines.en: I figured there was roughly a 50%% chance of her actually following me in, so I'm glad I was able to beat the odds this time around now.
lines.zh: 我本来估摸着她真跟进来的概率大概只有 50%%，所以这次能赢过概率我还挺高兴的。

lines.en: The only question now is whether I'll be able to get her to follow through...or if I'll wind up with nothing more than a little show between periods.
lines.zh: 现在唯一的问题是，我能不能让她做到底……还是说到头来只落得课间一场小小的表演。

lines.en: scene futabanurse19
: Um...Would you mind explaining to me why I’m on the bed now?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你能给我解释一下，我为什么现在在床上吗？

lines.en: : Sure. You’re going to take your shirt off.
lines.zh: : 当然。你要把上衣脱了。

lines.en: : I’m what?
lines.zh: : 我什么？

lines.en: : You’re going to take your shirt off.
lines.zh: : 你要把上衣脱了。

lines.en: scene futabanurse20
: Can we at least talk about this a little more?!
lines.zh: : 我们至少能再多讨论一下吧？！

lines.en: : What’s gotten into you today?
lines.zh: : 你今天到底是怎么了？

lines.en: : Being alone with you in a semi-secluded area obviously turned me on. Now take your shirt off and I’ll be on my merry way.
lines.zh: : 跟你单独待在一个半封闭的地方，显然让我来了兴致。现在把上衣脱了，我就心满意足地走人。

lines.en: scene futabanurse19
: If there’s anything I’ve learned about you lately it’s that you will absolutely not be {i}on your merry way...{/i}
lines.zh: : 要说最近我对你有什么了解的话，那就是你绝对不会{i}心满意足地走人{/i}……

lines.en: : You're going to want to do other stuff too. Stuff like...in those dreams you have.
lines.zh: : 你还会想做别的事。就像……你做的那些梦里的事。

lines.en: : Good point. We should probably do some of those too.
lines.zh: : 说得有道理。那些我们大概也该做一些。

lines.en: : That's just...crazy. We could get caught.
lines.zh: : 那太……疯了。我们会被抓到的。

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : You know what needs to be done.
lines.zh: : 你知道该怎么做。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : But just one look and you're done.
lines.zh: : 不过只看一眼就结束哦。

lines.en: scene futabanurse21
Futaba unbuttons her blazer and tosses it to the side, immediately bringing her hands to her breasts to lift them up.
lines.zh: Futaba 解开西装外套的扣子往旁边一扔，随即双手捧住自己的胸把它们托了起来。

lines.en: : There...
lines.zh: : 这样……

lines.en: : It’s off...
lines.zh: : 脱掉了……

lines.en: : Look at me.
lines.zh: : 看着我。

lines.en: scene futabanurse22
: Why?...What do you want?...
lines.zh: : 为什么？……你想看什么？……

lines.en: : The bra needs to come off too.
lines.zh: : 胸罩也得脱掉。

lines.en: : Isn’t this enough for today?...I think gym class should be over soon and-
lines.zh: : 今天这样还不够吗？……体育课应该快结束了，而且——

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: : You know, I really don't like this new pattern of you getting me to do naughty stuff by just saying my name and staring at me.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真的不喜欢你这个新套路——光是喊我的名字、盯着我看，就让我去做这种下流的事。

lines.en: scene futabanurse23
Futaba lifts her bra up with trembling fingers before holding back her braid to give me a better look.
lines.zh: Futaba 用颤抖的手指把胸罩撩了上去，又把辫子拨到一边，好让我看得更清楚。

lines.en: Two enormous mounds appear before my eyes and awaken a primal instinct within me that could very well hurt this girl if I am not careful about suppressing it.
lines.zh: 两座巨大的山峰出现在我眼前，唤醒了我体内某种原始的冲动——如果我不好好压制，这股冲动很可能会伤到这个女孩。

lines.en: : Are you...happy now?...
lines.zh: : 你……现在满意了吗？……

lines.en: : This is one of the happiest days of my life.
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子最开心的日子之一。

lines.en: scene futabanurse24
: You really mean that?...They're not too...too...
lines.zh: : 你是真心的吗？……它们不会太……太……

lines.en: : I don't...really know how to say it...
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道该怎么说……

lines.en: : You’re beautiful, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你很美，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabanurse25
: Huh?
: I said you’re beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我说你很美。

lines.en: : But...I’m-
: Don’t even think about putting yourself down again. Just come over here.
lines.zh: : 别再想着贬低自己了。过来就好。

lines.en: : Why?...What are you going to do, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为什么？……你要做什么，Sensei？

lines.en: : Have you try out that thing we were talking about earlier.
lines.zh: : 让你试试我们刚才说的那件事。

lines.en: scene futabanurse26
: The...b...boob job thing?...
lines.zh: : 那、那个……胸推的事？……

lines.en: : But I...still don't know how...
lines.zh: : 可是我……还是不知道怎么做……

lines.en: : Can I just use my hands again? I'm...more confident with those.
lines.zh: : 我能不能还是用手啊？我……用手更有自信。

lines.en: : I'm sure you'll be fine. And honestly, I can't imagine you'll have to do much work at all since looking at you has already gotten me half way to the end.
lines.zh: : 我相信你没问题的。说实话，我觉得你根本不用费什么劲，因为光是看着你，我就已经走完一半了。

lines.en: scene futabanurse27
: Hah...you’re really lucky I like you so much...
lines.zh: : 哈……你也真走运，我这么喜欢你……

lines.en: scene black
Futaba comes closer and helps me remove my pants.
lines.zh: Futaba 靠了过来，帮我把裤子脱掉。

lines.en: It’s a little worrying knowing that someone {i}could{/i} come in here at any moment, but I honestly don’t care about the risk at this point.
lines.zh: 明知随时{i}可能{/i}有人进来是有点让人担心，但事到如今我是真的不在乎这个风险了。

lines.en: I just want to get off as quickly as possible before anyone finds us...
lines.zh: 我只想在被人发现之前，尽快解决掉……

lines.en: I lie down on my back and guide her into the proper position.
lines.zh: 我仰面躺下，引导她摆好正确的姿势。

lines.en: scene futabanurse28
: It...feels a little weird...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 感觉……有点奇怪……Sensei……

lines.en: : Don’t call me Sensei right now...
lines.zh: : 现在别叫我 Sensei……

lines.en: scene futabanurse29
: What...would you like me to call you instead?...
lines.zh: : 那……你希望我叫你什么呢？……
